title: 用 SQL 向数据库提问
strings: "Unknown, so WHERE drops Eli. Use city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Paris' if he should be included."
"结果未知，所以 WHERE 会丢掉 Eli。如果应该包含他，请用 city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Paris'。"
"city <> 'Paris'   -- Eli, city is NULL"
"city <> 'Paris'   -- Eli 的 city 是 NULL"
' For INNER JOIN, a condition in ON or in WHERE gives the same result.'
' 对 INNER JOIN 来说，条件放在 ON 里还是 WHERE 里，结果都一样。'
' Now the condition is part of the match on the preserved side: small orders are still kept, just without a customer.'
' 现在条件成了被保留一侧匹配规则的一部分：小额订单仍会保留，只是没有对应的顾客。'
' The WHERE runs after the join, so it removes small orders, as you would expect here: the filter is on the preserved side.'
' WHERE 在连接之后执行，所以它会去掉小额订单，这里正符合预期：过滤条件作用在被保留的那一侧。'

' With WHERE o.amount > 50, every row with a NULL amount fails the filter (NULL > 50 is not TRUE): Gus and Hana disappear, and so do customers whose orders are all small. Unmatched orders over 50, like order 10, survive. The FULL JOIN now behaves like a RIGHT JOIN. Move the condition into ON to keep every row.'
'加上 WHERE o.amount > 50 后，amount 为 NULL 的行都无法通过过滤（NULL > 50 不为 TRUE）：Gus 和 Hana 消失了，订单金额都很小的客户也消失了。而没有匹配客户、金额大于 50 的订单（比如订单 10）保留了下来。FULL JOIN 现在的行为等同于 RIGHT JOIN。把条件移到 ON 里就能保留每一行。'

' With WHERE o.amount > 50, the NULL-padded rows fail the filter (NULL > 50 is not TRUE), and so do customers whose orders are all small. The outer join has turned into an INNER JOIN. Move the condition into ON to keep every customer.'
' 加上 WHERE o.amount > 50 后，用 NULL 补齐的行无法通过过滤（NULL > 50 不是 TRUE），订单都很小的顾客也一样。外连接变成了 INNER JOIN。把条件挪进 ON，才能保留每一位顾客。'
' With the condition in ON, it only decides which orders count as a match. Every customer is kept, Dev and Fay get NULL rows, and the small orders now appear on their own with a NULL customer.'
'条件放在 ON 里时，它只决定哪些订单算作匹配。每个客户都会保留，Dev 和 Fay 得到 NULL 行，而小额订单则单独出现，客户列为 NULL。'
' With the condition in ON, it only decides which orders count as a match. Every customer is kept; Dev and Fay, who only have small orders, now get NULL rows.'
' 条件放在 ON 里时，它只决定哪些订单算作匹配。每位顾客都会保留；只有小额订单的 Dev 和 Fay 现在得到的是 NULL 行。'
'3 random products'
'随机 3 件商品'
'7 and 7'
'A full scan with no ordering: the row order is whatever the plan produces.'
'全表扫描且不排序：行的顺序取决于执行计划。'
'AVG(rating) divides by the number of non-NULL ratings. A bucket whose ratings are all NULL gets NULL, not 0. Use COALESCE(rating, 0) only if a missing rating really means 0.'
'AVG(rating) 除以的是非 NULL 评分的个数。如果一个桶的评分全是 NULL，结果是 NULL 而不是 0。只有当缺失的评分确实等于 0 时，才用 COALESCE(rating, 0)。'
'Aggregates skip NULLs, so the average is (4 + 2) / 2 = 3. It would be NULL only if every rating were NULL.'
'聚合函数会跳过 NULL，所以平均值是 (4 + 2) / 2 = 3。只有所有评分都是 NULL 时，结果才是 NULL。'

'All 11 rows stay. Each partition (shaded bands) restarts ROW_NUMBER at 1, and the running SUM adds up within the customer in id order. Typical uses: top-N per group, running totals, and comparing a row with its group.'
'11 行全部保留。每个分区（带底色的色带）的 ROW_NUMBER 都从 1 重新开始，累计 SUM 按 id 顺序在同一位顾客内累加。典型用途：每组取前 N 名、累计总额，以及把一行和它所在的组做比较。'
'All customers'
'所有顾客'
'All rows'
'所有行'
'An error in every database'
'在任何数据库里都报错'
'An error'
'报错'
'Any comparison with NULL is unknown, even with NULL itself.'
'任何与 NULL 的比较结果都是未知，即使和 NULL 自己比较也一样。'
'Blocking the word DROP'
'屏蔽 DROP 这个词'
'COUNT(*) counts rows. COUNT(col) counts non-NULL values of col.'
'COUNT(*) 统计行数。COUNT(col) 统计 col 中非 NULL 值的个数。'
'COUNT(rating) skips NULLs. Across all orders, COUNT(*) is 11 but COUNT(rating) is 7, because 4 orders are not rated yet.'
'COUNT(rating) 会跳过 NULL。在全部订单上，COUNT(*) 是 11，而 COUNT(rating) 是 7，因为有 4 笔订单还没有评分。'
'Change one option and run again to see how the result changes.'
'改一个选项再运行一次，看看结果怎么变。'
'Comparisons with NULL are unknown, never TRUE. Use IS NULL.'
'与 NULL 的比较结果是未知，永远不是 TRUE。请用 IS NULL。'
'Copied'
'已复制'
'Copy failed'
'复制失败'
'Copy'
'复制'
'Customers without orders'
'没有订单的顾客'
'DESC sorts from largest to smallest, and LIMIT 3 keeps the top 3 rows.'
'DESC 从大到小排序，LIMIT 3 保留最前面的 3 行。'
'Escaping quotes by hand'
'手动转义引号'
'Every customer with their city'
'每位顾客及其城市'
'FROM (and any JOINs) builds the working set: 11 rows, all columns. Nothing else exists yet.'
'FROM（以及所有 JOIN）构建出工作集：11 行，所有列。此时其他东西都还不存在。'
'FROM: the database starts by loading the table. All 11 orders are on the table, with every column.'
'FROM：数据库先把表加载进来。11 笔订单全部摆在面前，所有列都在。'
'FULL OUTER JOIN preserves unmatched rows from both sides: Gus and Hana with NULL orders, and order 10 with a NULL customer.'
'FULL OUTER JOIN 保留两侧所有没有匹配的行：Gus 和 Hana 的订单列为 NULL，订单 10 的顾客列为 NULL。'
'GROUP BY makes one bucket per city, and COUNT(*) counts the rows in each bucket.'
'GROUP BY 为每个城市建一个桶，COUNT(*) 统计每个桶里的行数。'
'GROUP BY partitions the rows into 5 groups (NULL forms its own group). From here on, each group is one row.'
'GROUP BY 把行划分成 5 组（NULL 自成一组）。从这里开始，每组就是一行。'
'GROUP BY treats all NULLs as one group, even though NULL = NULL is not TRUE.'
'GROUP BY 把所有 NULL 视为同一组，尽管 NULL = NULL 并不是 TRUE。'
'GROUP BY: rows with the same customer_id go into one bucket. 9 rows become 5 buckets, including one for NULL.'
'GROUP BY：customer_id 相同的行进入同一个桶。9 行变成 5 个桶，其中一个是 NULL。'
'HAVING can use COUNT or SUM because it runs after the buckets exist. WHERE could not.'
'HAVING 能用 COUNT 或 SUM，因为它在桶建好之后才执行。WHERE 做不到。'
'HAVING filters groups and may use aggregates. 3 groups pass COUNT(*) >= 2.'
'HAVING 过滤分组，可以使用聚合函数。有 3 组满足 COUNT(*) >= 2。'
'HAVING filters whole groups after they are counted. WHERE runs before grouping, so the count does not exist yet.'
'HAVING 在计数之后过滤整个分组。WHERE 在分组之前执行，那时还没有计数。'
'HAVING sees aggregates because it runs after GROUP BY. An aggregate in WHERE is an error.'
'HAVING 能看到聚合值，因为它在 GROUP BY 之后执行。在 WHERE 里写聚合函数会报错。'
'HAVING: whole buckets are checked. Only customers with at least 2 orders stay: 3 buckets.'
'HAVING：检查整个桶。只留下至少有 2 笔订单的顾客：3 个桶。'
'Hiding error messages'
'隐藏错误信息'
'How does SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) differ from GROUP BY customer_id?'
'SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) 和 GROUP BY customer_id 有什么不同？'
'INNER JOIN emits only pairs that satisfy the ON predicate. Unmatched rows on either side (Gus, Hana, order 10) vanish.'
'INNER JOIN 只输出满足 ON 谓词的配对。两侧没有匹配的行（Gus、Hana、订单 10）都会消失。'
'INNER JOIN keeps only pairs that match. Gus and Hana have no orders, and order 10 has no customer, so all three are left out (faded).'
'INNER JOIN 只保留能配上对的行。Gus 和 Hana 没有订单，订单 10 没有顾客，所以这三个都被排除了（变淡）。'
'INNER JOIN only keeps rows that have a match on both sides.'
'INNER JOIN 只保留两侧都能匹配上的行。'
'IS NULL is the correct test. Eli is found.'
'IS NULL 才是正确的判断方式。找到了 Eli。'
'IS NULL is the test made for this. It never returns NULL.'
'IS NULL 就是专门干这个的。它永远不会返回 NULL。'
'In FROM'
'写在 FROM 里'
'In HAVING'
'写在 HAVING 里'
'In ORDER BY'
'写在 ORDER BY 里'
'In WHERE'
'写在 WHERE 里'
'In standard SQL, which clause can refer to the alias total?'
'在标准 SQL 中，哪个子句可以引用别名 total？'
'It can only be used with ORDER BY'
'它只能和 ORDER BY 一起用'
'It expands to 3 <> 1 AND 3 <> 2 AND 3 <> NULL. The last part is NULL, so the whole thing can never be TRUE.'
'它展开为 3 <> 1 AND 3 <> 2 AND 3 <> NULL。最后一部分是 NULL，所以整个表达式永远不可能是 TRUE。'
'It ignores NULL customers'
'它会忽略 NULL 顾客'
'It is just faster syntax'
'只是更快的写法'
'It keeps every row and adds the group total next to each one'
'它保留每一行，并在每行旁边加上该组的总额'
'LEFT JOIN keeps every customer. Gus and Hana have no orders, so their order columns are filled with NULL. Order 10 has no customer, so it is still left out.'
'LEFT JOIN 会保留每一位顾客。Gus 和 Hana 没有订单，所以他们的订单列用 NULL 填充。订单 10 没有顾客，所以仍然被排除。'
'LEFT JOIN keeps every row from the left table and fills the missing side with NULL.'
'LEFT JOIN 保留左表的每一行，缺失的那一侧用 NULL 填充。'
'LEFT JOIN preserves every left row; customers without a match are padded with NULLs on the right. Unmatched right rows (order 10) are dropped.'
'LEFT JOIN 保留左表的每一行；没有匹配的顾客在右侧用 NULL 补齐。右表中没有匹配的行（订单 10）被丢弃。'
'LIMIT applies last. With ORDER BY + LIMIT, many engines use a top-N sort and never sort the full set.'
'LIMIT 最后才生效。ORDER BY + LIMIT 时，很多引擎会用 top-N 排序，根本不对整个结果集排序。'
'LIMIT without ORDER BY gives you some rows, but which ones is not guaranteed. Add ORDER BY to make it predictable.'
'没有 ORDER BY 的 LIMIT 会给你一些行，但具体是哪些行没有保证。加上 ORDER BY 才能让结果可预期。'
'LIMIT without ORDER BY is non-deterministic: the database may return any qualifying rows.'
'没有 ORDER BY 的 LIMIT 是不确定的：数据库可能返回任意满足条件的行。'
'LIMIT: finally, keep only the first 2 rows. That is the answer.'
'LIMIT：最后只保留前 2 行。这就是答案。'
'NOT EXISTS only asks whether a matching row exists, so NULLs in orders cannot spoil it. Gus and Hana are found. Prefer it over NOT IN with subqueries.'
'NOT EXISTS 只问“是否存在匹配的行”，所以 orders 里的 NULL 影响不了它。找到了 Gus 和 Hana。用子查询时，优先用它而不是 NOT IN。'
'NULL > 50 is not TRUE, so WHERE drops the NULL-padded rows. Put the condition in ON to keep them.'
'NULL > 50 不是 TRUE，所以 WHERE 会丢掉用 NULL 补齐的行。把条件放进 ON 才能保留它们。'
'No WHERE, no ORDER BY, no LIMIT: you get every row, in whatever order the database finds them.'
'没有 WHERE、没有 ORDER BY、也没有 LIMIT：你会拿到所有行，顺序就是数据库找到它们的顺序。'
'No customer has that name.'
'没有叫这个名字的顾客。'
'No rows'
'没有行'
'No rows, ever'
'永远没有行'
'ORDER BY runs after SELECT, so it is the one clause that can reference output aliases in standard SQL.'
'ORDER BY 在 SELECT 之后执行，所以在标准 SQL 中，它是唯一能引用输出别名的子句。'
'ORDER BY: runs after SELECT, so it can use the name "total". Biggest total first.'
'ORDER BY：在 SELECT 之后执行，所以可以用名字“total”。总额最大的排在最前。'
'One FALSE is enough for AND.'
'对于 AND，只要有一个 FALSE 就够了。'
'One TRUE is enough for OR, whatever the unknown value turns out to be.'
'对于 OR，只要有一个 TRUE 就够了，不管那个未知值最终是什么。'
'One row per city, with how many customers live there'
'每个城市一行，以及住在那里的顾客人数'
'Only ORDER BY runs after SELECT. MySQL and SQLite also accept the alias in HAVING (and PostgreSQL in GROUP BY) as an extension, but portable SQL repeats the expression: HAVING SUM(amount) > 100.'
'只有 ORDER BY 在 SELECT 之后执行。MySQL 和 SQLite 作为扩展也允许在 HAVING 中使用别名（PostgreSQL 允许在 GROUP BY 中使用），但可移植的 SQL 会重复写表达式：HAVING SUM(amount) > 100。'
'Only the guest order'
'只有访客订单'
'Order 10 has no customer, so it lands in a bucket of its own: NULL.'
'订单 10 没有顾客，所以它单独进了一个桶：NULL。'
'Parameterized queries (placeholders)'
'参数化查询（占位符）'
'Parameters are sent separately from the SQL text, so input can never change the structure of the query. Filters and escaping miss cases.'
'参数与 SQL 文本分开发送，所以输入永远改变不了查询的结构。过滤和转义总会有遗漏。'
'Prefer WHERE for row filters: it shrinks the input before the aggregation does any work. HAVING is for conditions on aggregates.'
'行级过滤优先用 WHERE：它在聚合开始之前就缩小了输入。HAVING 用于针对聚合结果的条件。'
'Press Run to evaluate the query.'
'点“运行”来求值这条查询。'
'Press Run to evaluate.'
'点“运行”来求值。'
'Press Run to send the query to the database.'
'点“运行”，把查询发给数据库。'
'Press Run to watch the rows go into buckets.'
'点“运行”，看数据行怎样被放进各个桶。'
'Products that cost 3'
'价格为 3 的商品'
'Put the clauses in the logical order the database evaluates them.'
'把各子句按数据库逻辑求值的顺序排好。'
'Put the parts of a query in the order you write them.'
'把查询的各部分按书写顺序排好。'
'RIGHT JOIN preserves every order instead. The guest order 10 appears with NULL customer columns, while Gus and Hana are dropped. It equals orders LEFT JOIN customers.'
'RIGHT JOIN 改为保留每一笔订单。访客订单 10 出现了，顾客列为 NULL，而 Gus 和 Hana 被丢弃。它等价于 orders LEFT JOIN customers。'
'Ratings in a group are 4, NULL, 2. What is AVG(rating)?'
'一组里的评分是 4、NULL、2。AVG(rating) 是多少？'
'Rows where city is missing'
'city 缺失的行'

'SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
???  -- which clause may use "total"?'

'SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
???  -- 哪个子句可以使用 “total”？'
'SELECT evaluates the output expressions and defines aliases (total). Earlier clauses ran before the alias existed. DISTINCT also applies here.'
'SELECT 计算输出表达式并定义别名（total）。更早的子句执行时别名还不存在。DISTINCT 也在这一步生效。'
'SELECT: only now are the output columns computed, and the name "total" is created. That is why WHERE, which ran earlier, cannot use it.'
'SELECT：直到这时才计算输出列，名字“total”也是这时才创建的。所以更早执行的 WHERE 用不了它。'
'Same result as before for normal input.'
'对普通输入，结果和之前一样。'
'Same tables, but now a LEFT JOIN (customers on the left). What happens to that customer?'
'还是这两张表，但改用 LEFT JOIN（customers 在左边）。那位顾客会怎样？'
'Some rows had NULL in that column. NULL is not equal or unequal to anything, so those rows were dropped.'
'有些行在这一列上是 NULL。NULL 既不等于也不“不等于”任何值，所以这些行被丢掉了。'
'Step through the logical processing order. The circles show the run order for each clause.'
'逐步走完逻辑处理顺序。圆圈显示每个子句的执行顺序。'
'Syntax error: the quote in the input ended the string early. Innocent names like O\'Brien break the query, and an attacker can probe it.'
'语法错误：输入里的引号提前结束了字符串。像 O’Brien 这样无辜的名字会让查询出错，攻击者也能借此试探。'
'That is the written order. Unit 4 showed that the database runs them in a different order, starting with FROM.'
'这是书写顺序。第 4 单元演示过，数据库执行它们的顺序不同，是从 FROM 开始的。'
'The 3 cheapest products'
'最便宜的 3 件商品'
'The 3 most expensive products'
'最贵的 3 件商品'
'The cities in alphabetical order only'
'只是按字母顺序排列的城市'
'The injected OR is valid SQL, but this comparison happens to be false, so only exact name matches come back. An attacker just picks a comparison that is always true.'
'注入的 OR 是合法的 SQL，但这个比较恰好为假，所以只返回名字完全匹配的行。攻击者只要换一个永远为真的比较就行了。'
'The input closed the string and added an OR comparison that is TRUE for every row. Every customer leaks. The same trick can bypass a login check.'
'输入闭合了字符串，并加上了一个对每一行都为 TRUE 的 OR 比较。所有客户的数据都泄露了。同样的手法可以绕过登录检查。'
'The numbered circles will show the order the database actually runs each line in. Press Next step.'
'带编号的圆圈会显示数据库实际执行每一行的顺序。点“下一步”。'
'The query fails'
'查询失败'
'The query is rejected'
'查询被拒绝'
'The quote closed the string and -- turned the rest of the query into a comment. Any check that came after the name, such as AND password = …, is silently skipped. That is how logins get bypassed.'
'引号闭合了字符串，-- 把查询的其余部分变成了注释。名字后面的任何检查（例如 AND password = …）都被悄悄跳过了。登录验证就是这样被绕过的。'
'The quote closes the string, the semicolon ends the statement, and DROP TABLE runs as a second statement. The customers table would be deleted. The -- turns the rest into a comment.'
'引号结束了字符串，分号结束了语句，DROP TABLE 作为第二条语句执行。customers 表会被删除。-- 把后面的内容变成了注释。'
'The total number of customers'
'顾客总人数'
'The whole input is compared as one plain value. Quotes and keywords have no special meaning, so nothing leaks and nothing breaks. 0 rows, because no customer has that name.'
'整个输入被当作一个普通的值来比较。引号和关键字没有任何特殊含义，所以既不会泄露也不会出错。结果是 0 行，因为没有顾客叫这个名字。'
'They appear once with empty order columns'
'出现一次，订单列为空'
'They appear once, with NULL in the order columns'
'出现一次，订单列为 NULL'
'They appear twice'
'出现两次'
'They appear with NULL order columns'
'出现，订单列为 NULL'
'They appear with amount 0'
'出现，金额为 0'
'They appear with an order of $0'
'出现，并带一笔 $0 的订单'
'They are left out'
'不会出现'
'They are removed, so it behaves like an INNER JOIN'
'被移除，所以效果和 INNER JOIN 一样'
'They get a fake order'
'得到一笔假订单'
'This order explains alias visibility: only ORDER BY comes after SELECT.'
'这个顺序解释了别名的可见性：只有 ORDER BY 在 SELECT 之后。'
'This query gives an error. Why?'
'这条查询会报错。为什么？'
'Try an option with dashed borders to see an edge case.'
'试试虚线边框的选项，看看边界情形。'
'WHERE is evaluated per row, before any grouping, so it cannot use aggregates or SELECT aliases. 9 rows remain.'
'WHERE 在任何分组之前逐行求值，所以不能使用聚合函数或 SELECT 中的别名。还剩 9 行。'
'WHERE only works with text columns'
'WHERE 只能用于文本列'
'WHERE removed rows before grouping, and HAVING removed whole buckets after.'
'WHERE 在分组前移除了行，HAVING 在分组后移除了整个桶。'
'WHERE runs before SELECT, so the name sale_price does not exist yet'
'WHERE 在 SELECT 之前执行，所以这时名字 sale_price 还不存在'
'WHERE runs before SELECT. Repeat the calculation instead: WHERE amount * 0.9 > 50. ORDER BY sale_price would work, because ORDER BY runs after SELECT.'
'WHERE 在 SELECT 之前执行。改为重复写一遍计算：WHERE amount * 0.9 > 50。ORDER BY sale_price 则可以，因为 ORDER BY 在 SELECT 之后执行。'
'WHERE tests each row and keeps the ones where the condition is true. SELECT picks columns, not rows.'
'WHERE 会检查每一行，保留条件为真的行。SELECT 挑的是列，不是行。'
'WHERE: each row is checked on its own. The 2 refunded orders are thrown away, 9 rows remain.'
'WHERE：逐行单独检查。2 笔已退款的订单被丢掉，还剩 9 行。'
'What does ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3 give you?'
'ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3 会给你什么？'
'What does SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city return?'
'SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city 返回什么？'
'What does WHERE city = NULL return?'
'WHERE city = NULL 返回什么？'
'What is the reliable defence against SQL injection?'
'防御 SQL 注入的可靠方法是什么？'
'Which part of a query keeps only some of the rows?'
'查询中的哪一部分只保留其中一部分行？'
'Window functions compute over a set of rows without collapsing them.'
'窗口函数在一组行上计算，但不会把它们压缩成一行。'
'Works for normal input. The danger is that the input becomes part of the SQL text.'
'普通输入可以正常工作。危险在于输入变成了 SQL 文本的一部分。'
'You cannot multiply in SQL'
'SQL 里不能做乘法'
'You join customers to orders with an INNER JOIN. What happens to a customer with no orders?'
'用 INNER JOIN 把 customers 和 orders 连接起来。没有订单的顾客会怎样？'
'You want only cities with more than 2 customers. Where does COUNT(*) > 2 go?'
'你只想要顾客多于 2 人的城市。COUNT(*) > 2 应该写在哪里？'
'Zero rows, although Gus and Hana have no orders. The guest order puts a NULL in the list, so id NOT IN (…, NULL) is never TRUE.'
'0 行，尽管 Gus 和 Hana 并没有订单。访客订单在列表里放进了一个 NULL，所以 id NOT IN (…, NULL) 永远不会是 TRUE。'
